response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT r.name, ds.points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), race_averages AS (SELECT name, AVG(points) as race_avg FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(race_avg) as avg_value FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.name, ra.race_avg, ra.race_avg - oa.avg_value as difference FROM race_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ra.race_avg > oa.avg_value ORDER BY ra.name
